grammar.key: Not only... but also... / 不仅...而且...
grammar.title: 这个结构用于连接两个并列的句子成分，强调后者
grammar.titleEn: Not only... but also... / 不仅...而且...
grammar.usage:
这个结构用于连接两个并列的句子成分，强调后者。它表示"不仅...而且..."，用于强调递进关系。通常，not only放在句首时，其后的主谓需要部分倒装（助动词/be动词提前），但本句中它连接的是两个谓语动词(helps和can allow)，主语相同，所以不倒装。
This structure is used to connect two parallel sentence elements, emphasizing the latter. It means 'not only... but also...' and is used to show a progressive relationship. Usually, when not only is placed at the beginning of a sentence, the subject and verb that follow need partial inversion (auxiliary/be verb comes first). However, in this sentence, it connects two predicate verbs (helps and can allow) with the same subject, so no inversion is needed.
notes:
中考重点：注意主谓一致和倒装规则。当not only...but also...连接两个主语时，谓语动词与but also后的主语保持一致。例如：Not only you but also he is a student. 当Not only置于句首强调时，其后的主句需要部分倒装。例如：Not only does he like English, but he also likes math.
Zhongkao Focus: Pay attention to subject-verb agreement and inversion rules. When not only...but also... connects two subjects, the verb agrees with the subject after but also. E.g., Not only you but also he is a student. When Not only is placed at the beginning of a sentence for emphasis, the main clause that follows requires partial inversion. E.g., Not only does he like English, but he also likes math.

exercises.explain: 选项D正确。'not only...but also...'连接两个并列的宾语'swimming'和'running'，结构平衡。选项A缺少助动词，主语'he'后应直接跟动词'likes'，但'Not only'在句首时，其后的主句需要部分倒装（应为'Not only does he like...'）。选项B和C中'swimming'和'running'是宾语，但'likes'是谓语动词，连接宾语时'not only'应放在'likes'之后。 / Option D is correct. exercises.q: In the sentence 'Not only the students but also the teacher is in the classroom.', the verb 'is' agrees with the subject 'the teacher'. / 在句子'Not only the students but also the teacher is in the classroom.'中，动词'is'与主语'the teacher'保持一致。

grammar.key: Gerund as Subject / 动名词作主语
grammar.title: 动名词（动词+ing）具有名词的性质，可以在句子中充当主语
grammar.titleEn: Gerund as Subject / 动名词作主语
grammar.usage:
动名词（动词+ing）具有名词的性质，可以在句子中充当主语。在这个句子中，Taking part in regular exercise 这个动名词短语是句子的主语，谓语动词是 is。使用动名词作主语通常表示一个泛指的概念或习惯性的动作。
A gerund (verb+ing) has the nature of a noun and can act as the subject in a sentence. In this sentence, the gerund phrase Taking part in regular exercise is the subject, and the predicate verb is is. Using a gerund as the subject often indicates a general concept or a habitual action.
notes:
中考重点：1. 动名词作主语时，谓语动词用单数形式。例如：Swimming is good for health. 2. 常考句型：It is + adj. + (for sb) + to do sth. 与 Doing sth is + adj. 的转换。例如：It is important to exercise. = Exercising is important.
Zhongkao Focus: 1. When a gerund acts as the subject, the predicate verb should be in the singular form. E.g., Swimming is good for health. 2. Frequently tested sentence pattern: conversion between 'It is + adj. + (for sb) + to do sth.' and 'Doing sth is + adj.'. E.g., It is important to exercise. = Exercising is important.

grammar.key: Modal Verb 'can' for Ability/Possibility / 情态动词'can'表能力/可能性
grammar.title: 情态动词 can 有多种用法，包括表示能力（ability）和可能性（possibility）
grammar.titleEn: Modal Verb 'can' for Ability/Possibility / 情态动词'can'表能力/可能性
grammar.usage:
情态动词 can 有多种用法，包括表示能力（ability）和可能性（possibility）。在本文的上下文中，虽然没有直接出现'can'，但相关句子'Every part in your body needs water to function properly.'暗示了身体各部分'能够'正常工作的条件是需要水。'can'表示能力时，意为"能够，会"。表示可能性时，意为"可能"。情态动词后接动词原形。
The modal verb can has several uses, including expressing ability and possibility. In the context of this text, although 'can' does not appear directly, the related sentence 'Every part in your body needs water to function properly.' implies the condition for each part of the body 'to be able to' work properly is water. When 'can' expresses ability, it means 'to be able to'. When expressing possibility, it means 'may' or 'might'. Modal verbs are followed by the base form of the verb.
notes:
中考重点：1. 区分情态动词：can (能力/可能性), could (过去能力/礼貌请求), may (可能性/许可), must (必须), should (应该)。2. 情态动词后接动词原形。3. 否定形式：can → cannot/can't; must → must not/mustn't。4. 一般疑问句将情态动词提前：Can you...? Must I...?
Zhongkao Focus: 1. Distinguish between modal verbs: can (ability/possibility), could (past ability/polite request), may (possibility/permission), must (necessity), should (advice). 2. Modal verbs are followed by the base form of the verb. 3. Negative forms: can → cannot/can't; must → must not/mustn't. 4. For yes/no questions, place the modal verb at the beginning: Can you...? Must I...?

exercises.q: The negative form of 'can' is 'can not' (two words) or 'cannot' (one word). Both are correct. / 'can'的否定形式是'can not'（两个词）或'cannot'（一个词）。两者都正确。

grammar.title: 祈使句用于发出命令、请求、建议或指示
grammar.usage:
祈使句用于发出命令、请求、建议或指示。其特点是以动词原形开头，主语you通常省略。否定形式在动词原形前加Don't。本句中，Keep是动词原形，省略了主语'You'，表示一种建议或指示。
Imperative sentences are used to give commands, requests, advice, or instructions. They are characterized by starting with the base form of the verb, and the subject you is usually omitted. The negative form adds Don't before the base form of the verb. In this sentence, Keep is the base form of the verb, the subject 'You' is omitted, and it expresses a suggestion or instruction.
notes:
中考重点：1. 识别祈使句：以动词原形开头，无主语（隐含主语you）。2. 否定形式：Don't + 动词原形。例如：Don't be late. 3. 表示委婉请求：Please + 动词原形... 或 动词原形..., please. 4. 'Let's...'也是祈使句的一种，表示建议。
Zhongkao Focus: 1. Identify imperative sentences: start with the base form of the verb, no subject (implied subject 'you'). 2. Negative form: Don't + base form of verb. E.g., Don't be late. 3. Expressing polite requests: Please + base form of verb... or Base form of verb..., please. 4. 'Let's...' is also a type of imperative sentence, expressing a suggestion.

grammar.title: 情态动词 'should' 用来给出建议或表达一种义务或正确的事情
grammar.titleEn: Modal Verb 'should' for Advice / 情态动词 'should' 表示建议
grammar.usage:
情态动词 'should' 用来给出建议或表达一种义务或正确的事情。它不像 'must' 那么强烈。在英语中，我们经常用 'should' 来告诉别人什么是对他们有益或正确的做法。
The modal verb 'should' is used to give advice or express what is a good idea or the right thing to do. It is less strong than 'must'. We often use 'should' to tell someone what is beneficial or correct for them.
notes:
中考提示：注意 'should' 后面跟动词原形。常见错误是加 'to'（如 should to do）或使用动词的过去式。考题可能要求你在建议、规则或健康指南的语境中识别或使用 'should'。
Zhongkao Tip: Note that 'should' is followed by the base form of the verb. A common mistake is adding 'to' (e.g., should to do) or using a past tense verb. Exam questions may ask you to identify or use 'should' in contexts of advice, rules, or health guidelines.

grammar.titleEn: Conjunction 'although' for Contrast / 连词 'although' 表示转折
grammar.usage:
连词 'although'（虽然，尽管）用于连接两个有对比或转折关系的句子。它引导一个让步状语从句，表示承认一个事实，但主句的内容依然成立或更重要。它通常放在句首，后面用逗号与主句隔开。
The conjunction 'although' is used to link two clauses that show contrast or concession. It introduces a dependent clause (concession) that states a fact, but the main clause presents a contrasting idea that is still true or more important. It is often placed at the beginning of the sentence, followed by a comma.
notes:
中考提示：注意 'although' 和 'but' 不能在同一句话中同时使用，这是中文思维常见的错误（如：Although... but...）。记住：'although' 引导从句，主句前不需要 'but'。中考完形填空或句型转换题常考这一点。
Zhongkao Tip: Be careful not to use 'although' and 'but' in the same sentence. This is a common mistake due to Chinese thinking (e.g., Although... but...). Remember: 'although' introduces the clause, and 'but' is not needed before the main clause. This is often tested in cloze tests or sentence transformation questions.

exercises.q: What is the key grammar rule to remember when using 'although'? / 使用 'although' 时要记住的关键语法规则是什么？

C. It introduces a contrasting idea and doesn't need 'but' in the main clause. / 它引出一个相对的意思，在主句中不需要 'but'。

grammar.titleEn: Imperative Sentences for Instructions / 祈使句表示指示
grammar.usage:
祈使句用来发出命令、指示、请求或建议。它的主语（you）通常被省略，以动词原形开头。在说明文或指南中（如洗手步骤），祈使句被广泛用于清晰地给出指令。
Imperative sentences are used to give commands, instructions, requests, or advice. The subject (you) is usually omitted, and the sentence begins with the base form of the verb. In expository writing or guides (like handwashing steps), imperatives are widely used to give clear instructions.
notes:
中考提示：识别祈使句的关键是看句子是否以动词原形开头（没有主语），并且表达指令或建议。注意否定祈使句用 'Don't' + 动词原形。考题可能要求你将陈述句改为祈使句，或在语境中判断句子的功能。
Zhongkao Tip: The key to identifying an imperative sentence is to see if it starts with the base form of a verb (no subject) and expresses a command or instruction. Note that negative imperatives use 'Don't' + base verb. Exam questions may ask you to change a statement into an imperative, or judge the function of a sentence in context.

grammar.titleEn: Passive Voice in Present Simple / 一般现在时的被动语态
grammar.usage:
这个句子本身是主动语态，但它隐含了一个重要的被动概念：'germs are washed away'。为了教学清晰，我们提取其核心的被动结构：Germs are washed away. 被动语态强调动作的承受者（germs），而不是执行者（you）。一般现在时被动语态的结构是：am/is/are + 过去分词。它常用于科学描述、流程说明或当动作执行者不重要或未知时。
This sentence itself is in active voice, but it implies an important passive concept: 'germs are washed away'. For teaching clarity, we extract its core passive structure: Germs are washed away. The passive voice emphasizes the receiver of the action (germs), not the doer (you). The structure for present simple passive is: am/is/are + past participle. It is often used in scientific descriptions, process explanations, or when the doer is unimportant or unknown.
notes:
中考提示：判断是否使用被动语态的关键是：主语是动作的承受者。注意动词必须是及物动词。中考常考主动语态与被动语态的转换，例如将 'People wash germs away.' 改为 'Germs are washed away (by people).'。要熟练掌握 'be' 动词随主语单复数的变化（am/is/are）。
Zhongkao Tip: The key to deciding whether to use passive voice is: the subject is the receiver of the action. Note the verb must be transitive. The exam often tests the conversion between active and passive voice, e.g., changing 'People wash germs away.' to 'Germs are washed away (by people).'. Master the change of the 'be' verb according to the subject's number (am/is/are).

exercises.q: In the idea 'germs are washed away', what is the subject? Is it doing the action or receiving the action? / 在 'germs are washed away' 这个意思中，主语是什么？它是执行动作还是承受动作？

B. Germs - receiving the action (细菌 - 承受动作)

exercises.q: Which sentence is in the present simple passive voice?
options: A. The boy washes the apple.
B. The apple is washed by the boy.
C. The boy is washing the apple.
D. The boy has washed the apple.
exercises.explain: 正确选项是 B。主语 'The apple' 是动作 'wash' 的承受者，结构是 'is' + 过去分词 'washed'。A 是主动语态，C 是现在进行时主动语态，D 是现在完成时主动语态。

exercises.q: Change the active sentence into passive: 'People speak Chinese in China.'
options: A. Chinese is spoke in China by people.
B. Chinese is spoken in China (by people).
C. Chinese are spoken in China.
D. In China is spoken Chinese.
exercises.explain: 正确选项是 B。主语 'Chinese' 是单数，所以用 'is'，动词 'speak' 的过去分词是 'spoken'。'by people' 可以省略。A 的过去分词 'spoke' 错误，C 的主谓 'Chinese are' 单复数不一致，D 语序错误。

exercises.q: What is the past participle of the verb 'wash'? / 动词 'wash' 的过去分词是什么？
exercises.explain: 正确选项是 B 'washed'。规则动词的过去分词通常在词尾加 -ed。这是构成被动语态和完成时态的必要部分。

grammar.key: Infinitives of Purpose / 动词不定式表示目的
grammar.title: 动词不定式 (to + 动词原形) 可以用来表示做某事的目的或原因，回答“为什么
grammar.titleEn: Infinitives of Purpose / 动词不定式表示目的
grammar.usage:
动词不定式 (to + 动词原形) 可以用来表示做某事的目的或原因，回答“为什么？”的问题。在这个句子中，'to keep yourself safe' 解释了为什么我们要洗手。它比用 'in order to' 或 'so that' 从句更简洁，在说明文中非常常见。
The infinitive (to + base verb) can be used to express the purpose or reason for doing something, answering the question 'why?'. In this sentence, 'to keep yourself safe' explains why we wash our hands. It is more concise than using 'in order to' or a 'so that' clause and is very common in instructional writing.
notes:
中考提示：注意区分表示目的的 'to do' 和作为句子主语的 'To do...'（如：To learn English is important.）。在表示目的时，它通常放在主句之后。中考连词成句或单项选择可能考查不定式作目的状语的用法。记住，'to' 后面永远跟动词原形。
Zhongkao Tip: Distinguish between 'to do' for purpose and 'To do...' as the subject of a sentence (e.g., To learn English is important.). When expressing purpose, it usually comes after the main clause. The exam may test the use of infinitives as adverbials of purpose in sentence ordering or multiple-choice questions. Remember, 'to' is always followed by the base form of the verb.
